note: Factors named in the NBK base-rate statement of September 2026, compared with the frozen model (D53). Paraphrases are short and contain no numbers; each quote is at most 8 words, copied from the statement. China is not mentioned in the statement and is listed only because it was tested as a control (D50). Nothing here is a causal claim.

source.title: National Bank of Kazakhstan, Statement - base rate (decision of September 2026); statement by the Governor, Astana, 4 September 2026, posted on the BIS website (date delivered 22 September 2026)

overall_quote: the scope for further rate cuts is limited

rows.statement: Annual inflation kept declining and moved into single digits; the balance of risks is still described as pro-inflationary.
Household one-year-ahead expectations fell; unanchored expectations are named as a domestic risk.
GDP kept growing, driven by the non-oil sector; domestic demand is described as resilient.
rows.in_model: no GDP factor; demand enters only through consumption and lending

rows.statement: Retail trade and demand for services keep growing.
rows.in_model: consumption: BNS retail trade physical volume index, year-on-year

rows.statement: Consumer lending growth, including unsecured loans, is described as balanced.
rows.in_model: household lending (12-month log growth of loans to individuals); close to, not the same as, consumer lending

rows.statement: Lower import prices and the stronger tenge reduce import costs.
rows.in_model: imports (12-month log growth of import value); import prices themselves are not in the model

rows.statement: A stable and appreciating tenge is described as disinflationary.
Inflation in Russia accelerated and the Bank of Russia cut its key rate; Russia is called the key trading partner.
Inflation in the EU accelerated; the ECB kept its rates unchanged.
US inflation is slowing; the Federal Reserve keeps a restrictive tone.
rows.quote: continues to maintain a restrictive tone

rows.statement: The baseline oil price assumptions are broadly unchanged.
rows.quote: the oil price assumptions remain broadly unchanged

rows.statement: Not mentioned in the statement; tested as a control.
